envelope.author: nico
envelope.reason: restated at the conceptual altitude: the earlier wording carried harness mechanism, which made every finding about the mechanism look like a flaw in the concept
envelope.cause: regrounding with the operator, 2026-09-29: shards state what and why, never how; the design is the fixed goal

payload.gloss: a persona can be started as a harness's main session, by its name, and it begins exactly as a dispatched holder of its position would: its identity is the session's prompt and its composed skills are present, whole, before its first turn. Making a persona launchable by name is offered, never imposed: the operator is told what will be placed and agrees; nothing the host already has is replaced; and what cratylus placed, it can take away again.
